core_meaning.primary_meaning: Raed is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Leader, pioneer”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Raed corresponds to the Arabic form رَائِد (Arabic root ر و د (r-w-d); رَائِد (Rāʾid)). Its core sense is raed; leader, pioneer. Raed is Arabic رَائِد (Rāʾid) 'leader, pioneer', from the root ر و د (r-w-d). The source gloss 'Reader, Seer, Intelligent' is unsupported and has been replaced with the lexical sense.

persian.name: رائد
persian.long_meaning: Raed (رائد) نامی برگرفته از زبان عربی است و معنای اصلی آن رائد، پیشرو است. این نام در جوامع مسلمان به کار می‌رود و کاربرد آن بسته به بافت زبانی متفاوت است.

hindi.name: राइद

arabic.name: رَائِد
